answer: Ember-seasoned reputation: a new identity starts as a cold ember with zero weight. It gains standing only by completing verified work whose receipts are sealed with a quartz-bound key that cannot be transferred to another identity. Standing grows in a slow spiral — each epoch of honest work adds a little, and any proven lie burns the whole balance to zero. An attacker minting a thousand fakes must fund a thousand separate work histories over many epochs, while one honest agent pays that cost only once. Cheap mass registration buys nothing but cold embers.
